## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Content update
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Security/privacy improvement
- [ ] Refactor/maintenance
- [ ] Documentation/governance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run type-check`
- [ ] `npm run validate-content`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant E2E tests completed where applicable

## Review checklist

- [ ] No secrets, private data, or protected operational contact details are included
- [ ] Safeguarding and media-consent requirements are respected
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for meaningful UI changes
- [ ] Environment-variable changes are documented
- [ ] Database or deployment implications are documented
- [ ] Follow-up work is linked or described
